messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're targeting tonight's 23:00 UTC quiet window for the payments schema migration. Dual-write will start at 23:15. Please confirm owners and smoke plan. @tasha you're runbook owner, right?

tasha: Yep. I'll own the run. Backfill scheduled to start 23:30, will monitor backfill batch-by-batch. I'll be on call from 22:45-01:00. Will also keep an eye on replication lag and backfill throughput.

mike: I'll coordinate app rollout and feature flag. Plan: route 5% canary at 23:20, then ramp to 50% at 23:40 if no errors. I'll post the traffic shift commands beforehand.

lina: SRE here — I'll run smoke checks and DB monitors. My quick checklist: `pg_replication_lag`, `error_5xx_rate`, `queue_depth`. I'll post results in this thread every 10m once we start.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window reserved: 2024-11-15 23:00 UTC — slot reserved by @alex. ID: MW-8723

tasha: Smoke commands (run from bastion):
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env prod --path /v1/payments/health
# expect: HTTP 200 returned within 500ms for canary host
```

sam: Quick question — if replication lag > 2m during backfill, what's the rollback trigger? We agreed earlier on manual rollback + disable dual-write, right?

alex: Rollback plan: stop dual-write, flip feature flag to old-schema, fail open at app level. Tasha will execute `./ops/rollback_dualwrite.sh` (runbook has the exact steps). Manual decision by migration owner + SRE.

lina: I'll set alert thresholds: lag > 120s, 5xx > 1% sustained for 2m. If triggered I'll escalate to #oncall and ping infra lead.

mike: Also pinging @tasha for a very small migration script tweak I pushed. Code review please — 3-line change to batching logic.

tasha: Reviewed and pushed the tweak. :thumbsup:

alex: Ownership recap: @tasha = runbook & migration owner, @mike = app rollout/flags, @lina = SRE monitoring & smoke, @sam = backups/snapshot + watch. Anyone else to add?

sam: I'll create DB snapshot at 22:50 and attach snapshot ID here before we start.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift scheduled: 2024-11-15 23:20 UTC -> 5% for 20m

lina: I'll post smoke results every 10m during the window, starting at 23:10 (pre-check).

tasha: Post-backfill verification step: run `SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE migrated = true;` and compare to pre-migration snapshot counts. I'll include the query and expected deltas in the runbook.

alex: Thanks team. If no objections, proceed with the scheduled window. Leave final ack here so we have a quick audit trail.

mike: ACK

lina: ACK (will be on pager) :eyes:

tasha: ACK — runbook is up-to-date and I've saved the rollback script to ops vault.

sam: ACK — snapshot scheduled and verified.
